newsitem.title: INDIA: Eight killed in India as mob goes on rampage.
newsitem.headline: Eight killed in India as mob goes on rampage.

text.p: At least eight people were killed and 65 injured on Thursday when a mob of around 1,000 villagers set fire to scores of houses in the Indian state of West Bengal, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.

PTI quoted police as saying villagers set at least 150 houses on fire in the eastern state's North Dinajpur district, about 400 km (250 miles) from the state capital Calcutta, after a local rice trader was killed and his body found in a pond.
Police arrested some 20 people for involvement in the crime, the news agency said. It was unclear why the houses were targeted.
